title: 4 ETFs to BUY for the Rest of 2026
creator: Mark Roussin CPA
summary: Mark Roussin CPA recommends four ETFs to buy for the rest of 2026, framed as portfolio completion around an AI-heavy core. His #1 pick (35% sleeve): XLG — the S&P 500 top-50 mega-cap earnings ETF, a quality mega-cap tilt. SCHD — BUY (reiteration of his Oct 3 BUY): the quality-dividend ETF with ~3.2% yield and ~7%/yr dividend growth, positioned as the offset to tech overexposure. XLI — BUY: industrials after roughly a 10% pullback, which he recently bought himself; a play on physical-economy capex at a 20% sleeve. AIPO — BUY: the Defiance AI & Power Infrastructure ETF, his highest-risk pick at a 15% sleeve, with ~55% industrials exposure including names like Eaton, Quanta, and GE Vernova — a direct AI-infrastructure buildout play. The video is pure ETF positioning (no individual stock calls), pairing dividend quality and industrials with continued mega-cap tech exposure through year-end. Calls: SCHD BUY (reiteration), XLG BUY, XLI BUY, AIPO BUY — all BUY, no flips. No single-stock recommendations; brief mentions of Eaton, Quanta, and GE Vernova are only as AIPO constituents, not calls.
